planItem: 77.44.7.A — Creator Embed Inspector validation and public renderer lifecycle
finding: The Creator Embed source input exposed a live provider-validation status, but aria-describedby only referenced the composition helper's message. Screen-reader users could not directly find the provider-specific URL status.
change: Assign a unique id to the existing live status and append it to the source input's aria-describedby tokens after the composition helper associates its own error message. Preserve the existing URL parser, IME validation, Save, and separate Publish behavior.
openSourceReview: Reused the existing project-owned composition-input accessibility association and provider allowlist parser; no external code or dependency was needed.

assertions: source field describedby includes exactly one existing live status ID
existing IME composition, provider parsing, click-to-load, draft Save, and separate Publish paths remain covered

acceptanceBoundary: This proves only the Creator Embed source status association and the existing tested flows. Full 77.44.7.A remains OPEN / NOT CERTIFIED; manual acceptance stays deferred until the complete Visual Editor is implemented.
